description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Jacobs is a company focused on solving critical problems across cities, environments, mission-critical operations, scientific discovery, and manufacturing. The company is seeking a Junior Software Developer to apply geolocation principles and software development practices while contributing to collaborative projects involving microservices, containerization, testing, and debugging.

Responsibilities:
• Knowledge of and experience in geolocation principles and practices
• Customer domain knowledge
• Knowledge of Git version control (branching, merging, pull requests)
• Experience working in collaborative team environments
• Familiarity with microservices architecture concepts
• Basic understanding of containerization (Docker)
• Knowledge of software testing principles and practices
• Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
• Excellent communication skills and willingness to learn

Requirements:
• Knowledge of and experience in geolocation principles and practices

• Experience working in collaborative team environments

• Knowledge of software testing principles and practices
• Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
• Excellent communication skills and willingness to learn
• BS in Computer Science, Mathematics, or related STEM discipline
• TS/SCI Clearance required to start this position
• 1-2 years of professional software development experience

Preferred:
• Proficiency with Go programming language (or other modern programming languages)
• Understanding of RESTful API design and development
• Exposure to Angular or other modern frontend frameworks
• Experience with Kubernetes or container orchestration platforms
• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and Gitlab workflows
• Knowledge of Helm charts or infrastructure-as-code tools
• Experience with API gateways (Traefik or similar)
• Exposure to distributed systems concepts
• Familiar with VS Code or modern development environments
